summary: Section C is a well-constructed, fully sourced treatment of DHEA-S measurement and standardization: the Büttler 7-assay comparison (PMID 23665079, slope range 0.84–1.28, verified first author Rahel M Büttler + co-authors Kruit/Blankenstein/Heijboer), the CDC-HoSt standardization gap, the no-diurnal-variation pre-analytic advantage with half-life mechanistic reasoning (Rosenfeld PMID 123927, verified RS Rosenfeld + Rosenberg/Fukushima/Hellman), and the biotin/heterophile/cross-reactivity interference directions are all present and correctly sourced; Middle 2007 (PMID 17362583, solo author Jonathan G Middle, Ann Clin Biochem — sagepub.com whitelisted) verified; all 10 bibliography hosts are whitelisted; no bare citations; type_tag_discipline scores 90 rather than higher because Rosenfeld 1975 and Krasowski 2014 are primary observational/experimental studies tagged mechanism_review rather than the stricter cohort designation, though both are defensible given the mechanistic-characterization nature of the findings.
